hero.eyebrow: A divination and charting app with an AI cat that casts hexagrams and reads charts.
hero.headline1: When you're anxious, cast a hexagram first.
hero.headline2: To see it clearly, lay out a chart.
hero.description: Give two numbers and ask one thing. The Master casts a hexagram and reads it to you. To go deeper, add your birth details and get two charts: Zi Wei Dou Shu (Purple Star astrology) and Ba Zi (Four Pillars). All chart work runs on this phone.
hero.memory: A chatbot forgets what you asked last time. The Master remembers, cast after cast.

featureCards.title: Open Master Hachimi, four tabs at the bottom
featureCards.subtitle: The four tabs at the bottom are Ask, Chart, Academy, Me.
featureCards.cards.0.title: Ask
featureCards.cards.0.description: Write down what you want to ask, give two numbers on instinct, and the Master casts a hexagram by Mei Hua Yi Shu, then reads that hexagram back to you.
featureCards.cards.1.title: Chart
featureCards.cards.1.description: One birth date gives you both a Zi Wei Dou Shu chart and a Ba Zi chart. Switch between the San He chart, the Four Transformations chart, and the Flying Star chart at any time. Open the major cycle and the Annual step by step, and take your time.
featureCards.cards.2.title: Academy
featureCards.cards.2.description: The old texts of the five arts, Mountain, Medicine, Fate, Physiognomy and Divination, come with the app. Read them page by page. Press and hold a star name on the chart and a glossary card opens.
featureCards.cards.3.title: Me
featureCards.cards.3.description: Pick light, dark, or match your system under Appearance. The Language setting covers Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English. Save a case to Files, or keep a copy in iCloud.
chart.title: One birth time, two charts
chart.subtitle: Three chart styles, Chart Patterns and glossary cards all in one place
chart.blocks.0.title: Three chart styles, down to the hourly fortune layer
chart.blocks.0.body: One birth date gives you three charts: San He, Four Transformations, and Flying Star. A capsule at the bottom switches between them. Tap a cell to set the Taiji point, double tap to zoom into that palace, and step the fortune bar from major cycle down to hourly.
chart.blocks.0.bullets.0: Major cycle, Annual, minor cycle, Monthly, daily, hourly open in layers. Fortune panel: four specs, seven at start.
chart.blocks.0.bullets.1: Chart Patterns checks 84 rules one by one. Tap a layer, pattern or sign to open its text in place.
chart.blocks.0.bullets.2: Star Settings: 10 groups, 60+ items, adjustable by school, plus Zhongzhou heaven, earth and human boards and Chart adjust.
chart.blocks.0.bullets.3: The More menu also has zizhan chart without birth details, Four Pillars lookup, screenshot save, and text chart.
chart.blocks.0.shotAlts.0: Zi Wei Dou Shu fortune chart screenshot with the fortune bar set to Monthly
chart.blocks.0.shotAlts.1: Chart Patterns screen with fortune layer names, pattern names, and luck marks listed
chart.blocks.1.title: Four Pillars and Six Pillars tables that follow each major cycle step
chart.blocks.1.body: Switch to the Ba Zi side. Four tabs run in order: Profile, Chart, Details, Notes. Each pillar table has ten rows per pillar, from the main star and Heavenly Stem and Earthly Branch all the way down to Nayin and Symbolic Stars. Take your time.
chart.blocks.1.bullets.0: The Details chart is a seven column, six pillar table. One switch adds Conception Pillar, Life Palace and Body Palace.
chart.blocks.1.bullets.1: Major cycle in 12 steps, plus 12 slots each for Annual and Monthly. Slide across and tap any slot to switch the whole chart.
chart.blocks.1.bullets.2: Symbolic Stars sort by Four Pillars and major cycles, with clashes and combos marked where the chart meets the year.
chart.blocks.1.bullets.3: Take notes as you read your chart. They save when you stop, and you can export a full Ba Zi text chart.
chart.blocks.1.shotAlts.0: Ba Zi Chart tab screenshot, four pillars with ten rows each
chart.blocks.1.shotAlts.1: Ba Zi Details screenshot, six pillars table adds Conception Pillar, Life Palace, Body Palace
chart.blocks.2.title: Press and hold a name on the chart to read what it means
chart.blocks.2.body: On the chart, star names that have a glossary entry sit above a thin dotted line. Press and hold one and a half screen card rises from the bottom: the name, one line that says what it is, and body text you can open step by step, with a row at the bottom to read the full entry in Academy.
chart.blocks.2.bullets.0: The same star reads differently in each palace. Hold it in the Marriage Palace and the card opens with that view.
chart.blocks.2.bullets.1: San He, Flying Star and Four Transformations charts, plus Chart Patterns. Every entry name is tappable.
chart.blocks.2.shotAlts.0: Long press a star name on the Zi Wei chart to raise its glossary card
academy.title: All five arts, kept in one tab on your phone
academy.subtitle: Five arts: Mountain, Medicine, Fate, Physiognomy, Divination. 154 books included.
academy.body: The Academy screen lays out the five arts: Mountain, Medicine, Fate, Physiognomy and Divination. Tap an art to see its categories, tap a category to see its books. All 154 books and 2,408 chapters live on your device, so they open on a plane or deep underground.
academy.bullets.0: Open a book and you see its contents first, one chapter per page, the longest over sixty thousand words, and it scrolls.
academy.bullets.1: Illustrations sit right where they belong in the text: reach a chart, and it is on the next line.
academy.bullets.2: All 287 glossary entries ship in Simplified and Traditional, and search finds them by book or star name.

featureHighlight.title2: Your tangled thoughts, sorted step by step
featureHighlight.description: The hexagram is cast, and the Master walks you through it line by line. Each reading ends with one small thing you can do right now: send that message, clear out that drawer, or write three lines before bed.

faq.chart.0.question: Does charting need the internet?
faq.chart.0.answer: No. Both your Zi Wei Dou Shu and Ba Zi charts are worked out on your device by the chart engine that comes with the app. No signal, weak signal, or on a plane, open a case and the chart still appears. Step through a major cycle or Annual, change Star Settings, switch the language, and every move is calculated right there. Your birth details never leave the device.
faq.chart.1.question: How do the San He, Four Transformations and Flying Star charts differ?
faq.chart.1.answer: The same birth details give you the same chart, drawn three ways. The San He chart shows the twelve palaces with the three-way and four-corner groups. The Four Transformations chart draws the transformation letters and the flying lines. The Flying Star chart draws the flying stars from palace to palace. A capsule at the bottom of the Chart page switches between them at any time, and the Taiji point and fortune layers follow along.
faq.chart.2.question: Can I change the star school when setting up Zi Wei Dou Shu?
faq.chart.2.answer: Yes. Star Settings gives you ten groups and more than sixty switches, so you can set them to match the school you follow. You can also type in a star code and set all twenty-three slots at once. There are also the Zhongzhou heaven, earth and human boards and Chart adjustment. These help when you fix a chart for twins or start month-based stars from another school.
faq.chart.3.question: Are Ba Zi and Zi Wei two separate features?
faq.chart.3.answer: Both charts in the same tab use the same birth details. The pill at the bottom left of the Chart page shows Zi Wei and Ba Zi. Switch to it and you get the Ba Zi chart for this case: four tabs named Profile, Chart, Details and Notes. Whichever one you viewed last is the one that opens next time.
faq.chart.4.question: Will my cases be lost if I reinstall the app?
faq.chart.4.answer: The Case library page has a Save to Files button. Tap it, pick a folder, and you get a copy with the date in the file name. Open that file from Files, WeChat or AirDrop to import it back. By default it merges into your current cases, and for the same case the one with the newer update time wins. The top of the page shows when your last backup was.
faq.chart.5.question: Is there a dark mode?
faq.chart.5.answer: Yes. In the Me tab, pick Appearance. You get three settings: Light, Dark, and Follow System. They apply across the whole app, and the chart has its own light color set. Language lives in the same tab. Switch between Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English at any time, and the star and palace names on the chart change with it.
faq.chart.6.question: Do I have to download the old texts in Academy first?
faq.chart.6.answer: No. All 154 books and 2,408 chapters of the five arts: Mountain, Medicine, Fate, Physiognomy and Divination come installed with the app, pictures included. Tap and read, no loading spinner. The book list also shows three titles by name only. The 287 glossary entries are bundled too. Press and hold a star name with a dotted underline on the chart and its glossary card opens.
finalCta.headline: Cast a hexagram, or set a chart?
finalCta.note: Casting takes about half a minute, and charts are made on this phone.
methodology.metaTitle: How hexagram casting and chart building work
methodology.metaDescription: Here is how a hexagram is cast, where a third party AI service is held back and by what, and what rules shape a chart. The Master walks you through it, step by step.
methodology.intro: Master Hachimi lays it all out: the casting method is fixed, the reading is tightly bounded, every pass goes through evaluation, and the chart rules are written down line by line, all in plain view. For entertainment and reference only.
methodology.paipan.title: How the chart is built
methodology.paipan.body: Both charts, Zi Wei Dou Shu (Purple Star astrology) and Ba Zi (Four Pillars), come from the chart engine built into the app, running on your own phone. Same birth details, same Star Settings, same chart every time. A few spots cause the most differences, and the rules are here.
methodology.paipan.points.0.desc: Chart casting first converts birth time by birthplace longitude. Pick a province and city, type a longitude, or take your current location once. Born outside UTC+8? Choose a time zone too, down to half and quarter hour zones. Location uses longitude only and stores nothing.
methodology.paipan.points.1.desc: Birth details can be Gregorian, lunar, or Four Pillars. For lunar, pick a Gregorian or stem-branch year and tick leap month. Five cases get a chart note: daylight saving, leap month, late zi hour, two Four Pillars across a solar term change, and true solar time crossing an hour slot.
methodology.paipan.points.2.desc: Star placement rules differ by school, so nothing here is fixed for you. Ten groups and more than sixty items can be set one by one to match the school you follow, or you can enter a star code to set them all at once. The Zhongzhou heaven, earth and human boards have their own entry.
methodology.paipan.points.3.desc: Charts are built on your device, not on a server. Step to the next major cycle, change a Star Settings option, or switch the Language, and it all recalculates on the spot. You can build a chart with no network. Your birth details never leave this device.
config.tagline: Anxious? Cast a hexagram. Want clarity? Draw a chart.
config.description: Master Hachimi is a cat Daoist who casts hexagrams and reads charts. Give two numbers and write your question, and he casts by Mei Hua Yi Shu, Plum Blossom divination, and reads it to you. Enter your birth details, and your Zi Wei Dou Shu (Purple Star astrology) and Ba Zi (Four Pillars) charts are built on your phone, even with no internet. The Academy carries the old texts of the five arts: Mountain, Medicine, Fate, Physiognomy and Divination. For fun and company only, no predictions. No account, records stay on your device, no ads.
